name: Marshal
body:
The Marshal is a front line commander. Dictating the flow of battle and inspiring others to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. Supporting their allies on and off the battlefield, Marshals serve as the lynchpin in any party they join. Unlike the Bard or Cleric who may provide support with magic, the Marshal influences others through force of personality and leading by example, granting others the ability to strike harder and move faster among other boons.

Role: The marshal can be a front-line combatant as they are well versed in the use of arms and armor, but their true role is as a supportive leader in combat.

Providing a wide variety of options to keep combat moving and ensure each member of the party is doing their best.

Alignment: Any

Hit Die: d10

Starting Wealth: 4d6 × 10 gp (average 140 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The marshal’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (all) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier

Class Features

The following are the class features of the marshal.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The marshal is proficient with all simple and martial weapons as well as all armor and shields (including tower shields).

Inspire Action (Ex)

A marshal can inspire others to take actions on their turn. The ally must be within 60 feet of the marshal and as they gain levels more possible actions become available.

At 1st level, a marshal may, as a move action grant an ally the ability to take a move action as an immediate action. If used for movement, this move action does not count against the ally’s movement in their next turn.

At 5th level, as a standard action, a marshal may grant one ally the ability to make a charge attack as an immediate action. The targeted creature may only move up to their base movement speed during this charge and due to the sudden action the penalty to AC from charging is increased to -4 and they may only make a single attack at the end of the charge. During the following round the charging creature’s movement speed is reduced by 10 feet; otherwise this movement does not count against the creature’s movement during their next turn.

At 10th level, a marshal may target two creatures with inspire action when granting a move action or charge attack, both targets must be granted the same action.

This requires two uses of inspire action.

At 15th level, as a full round action, a marshal may switch initiative order with an ally who has a lower initiative than themself, allowing the target to take their turn as soon as the marshal’s has ended. For example if the marshal rolled a 19 initiative and an ally rolled a 14, the marshal could take a full round action to grant that ally an initiative of 19, acting immediately when the marshal’s turn ends. The marshal’s new initiative would be 14, but since they have already taken a turn this round, they would take their turn at initiative order in the following round.

At 20th level, as a move action, a marshal can grant an ally the ability to take a standard action as an immediate action.

A marshal may inspire action a number of times per day equal to 1/2 their class level plus their Charisma modifier and any actions granted by this ability must be used before the end of round.

Auras (Ex)

A marshal’s mere presence on the battlefield can turn the tide of any encounter by providing inspiration and support. Off the battlefield, the marshal can provide motivation for even mundane tasks. The marshal has access to all the auras listed below but may only ready a limited number of auras at once as shown on the table. If an aura provides a numerical bonus, it provides the bonus indicated on the table on page 1 starting at +1 at 1st level and increasing at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter to a maximum of +6 at 20th level. All bonuses granted by a marshal’s auras are circumstance bonuses unless otherwise listed. Affected allies must be within 60 feet of the marshal and able to both see and hear them, and the marshal always benefits from their own auras. The marshal may only have one aura active at a time and activating or deactivating an aura is a free action.

A marshal may ready auras or change their readied auras by taking 10 minutes to clear their mind and prepare for the tasks ahead.

Accuracy: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to attack rolls while flanking and on rolls made to confirm critical hits.
Mettle: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to Fortitude and Reflex saves.
Motivation: When readied, the marshal chooses an ability score. When this aura is active it adds the aura bonus to all skill checks made with that ability. This aura may be readied multiple times, choosing a different ability score for each.
Opportunity: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity and to attack rolls made as part of an attack of opportunity.
Position: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to Combat Maneuver Checks and to Combat Maneuver Defense.
Proficiency: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to reduce the total non-proficiency penalties for armor and weapons. This cannot reduce the penalty below 0. This bonus may be spread over multiple weapons and armor if applicable.
Spirit: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to Will saves and Concentration checks.
Spotting: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to ranged attacks outside of their 1st range increment. This bonus cannot exceed the penalty from range penalties.
Support: Affected creatures add 1/2 the aura bonus (minimum +1) to the bonus provided by their Aid Another action. This increase to the bonus provided by the affected creature’s Aid Another action does not stack with any other source that increases the bonus of Aid Another.
Tactics: Affected creatures add the aura bonus to damage rolls while flanking or charging.
Vigor: Creatures affected by this aura gain fast healing equal to the aura bonus but only as long as their hit point total is equal to or less than one one third their maximum hit points.
Major Auras (Ex)

At 10th level, a marshal’s presence becomes even more potent. They may now select from the following major auras to ready each day.

Adaptation: Affected creatures suffer no penalty to using weapons or casting spells while underwater, do not suffer from penalties related to altitude, and are not flat-footed while climbing or balancing.
Deadliness: Affected creatures increase the critical threat range of their weapons by 1/3 (minimum 1) the aura bonus. This does not stack with the increases provided by feats, abilities, or weapon enchantments.
Focus: Affected creatures gain a bonus on checks made to overcome spell resistance equal to the aura bonus.
Greater Tactics: This aura replaces tactics and applies the aura bonus to all weapon damage rolls.
Greater Vigor: This aura replaces vigor and grants fast healing to affected creatures as their hit point total is less than 50% of their maximum hit point total.
Initiative: Affected creatures gain a bonus to initiative equal to the aura bonus. When this aura is readied the marshal may choose to end another aura and activate this aura as a free action when rolling for initiative.
Protection: Affected creatures gain a bonus to Armor Class including touch Armor Class and when flat footed equal to the aura bonus.
Resilience: Affected creatures gain DR/– equal to the aura bonus.
Resistance: When readying this aura the marshal chooses from among acid, cold, electricity, fire or negative energy, This aura provides energy resistance to the chosen energy type equal to five times the aura bonus. This aura may be readied multiple times, choosing a different energy type for each.
Speed: Affected creatures gain a bonus to all move speeds equal to five times the aura bonus.
Vital Inspiration (Ex)

The marshal’s words can invigorate their allies’ bodies. Beginning with 2nd level, whenever a marshal uses the inspire action ability the target is also healed for 1d6 hit points for each point of aura bonus the marshal possesses plus additional hit points equal to 1/2 their class level.

Skill Focus (Ex)

Marshals often train for specific roles in an organization. At 3rd level, a marshal gains Skill Focus in the skill of their choice as a bonus feat.

Twin Aura (Ex)

The marshal’s presence becomes more vigorous. At 4th level a marshal may now have two auras active simultaneously.

Tactician (Ex)

All marshals are able to regulate any fighting force into a team. At 4th level, a marshal receives a teamwork feat as a bonus feat for which they meet the prerequisites. As a standard action, a marshal can grant any single teamwork feat they possess to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear them. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for 3 rounds plus 1 round for every two levels the marshal possesses. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats. A marshal can use this ability once per day at 4th level, plus one additional time per day at 8th level and for every 4 levels thereafter.

Inspiring Voice (Ex)

At 7th level, a marshal learns to aid allies under even the most adverse conditions. Allies need only see or hear the marshal, not both, to gain the benefit of auras, inspire action, or tactician.

Teamwork Feat (Ex)

At 8th level and again at 16th level, a marshal gains a bonus teamwork feat for which they meet the prerequisites.

Tactical Adjustment (Ex)

Some situations require the marshal to be a bit more flexible. At 9th level, as a swift action usable once per day, a marshal may lose a readied aura and ready a new aura in its place. At 13th level and again at 17th level a marshal may use this ability an additional time.

Triple Aura (Ex)

At 11th level, a marshal may now have three auras active simultaneously.

Greater Tactician (Ex)

At 12th level, a marshal gains an additional bonus teamwork feat for which they meet the prerequisites. Additionally, they may activate the tactician ability as a swift action.

Expanded Aura (Ex)

At 14th level, a marshal’s presence grows to be like a shadow cast over battlefields and great halls. Their aura expands to 100 feet.

Quadruple Aura (Ex)

At 19th level, a marshal may now have four auras active at a time.

Master Tactician (Ex)

At 20th level, a marshal gains an additional bonus teamwork feat for which they meet the prerequisites and may now grant two teamwork feats with each use of tactician.
